texts.li: {A_nameDef} sat up with {B_nameDef} through the worst night of the illness, changing the cloth on {B_possessive} forehead every hour.
{A_nameDef} slept in a chair by {B_nameDef}'s bed three nights running and wouldn't hear of anyone else taking a turn.
{A_nameDef} read aloud to {B_nameDef} through the long sick days, the same few stories over and over, because {B_nameDef} asked for them.
When {B_nameDef}'s fever was at its worst, {A_nameDef} held {B_possessive} hand and talked about nothing until morning.
{A_nameDef} put together a small supper to mark {B_nameDef}'s first week back on {B_possessive} feet, with a candle stuck in the bread.
{A_nameDef} carved {B_nameDef} a walking stick for the weak days after the illness, with {B_nameDef}'s name cut into the handle.
{A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} on a slow walk to the edge of the fields, the first since the illness, and they stood in the sun a while.
{A_nameDef} saved {B_nameDef} the best of every meal for a week to build {B_objective} back up, and wouldn't take no for an answer.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: who gave it to whom

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} came down with the same thing and spent an evening arguing over who gave it to whom.
{A_nameDef} told everyone at supper that {B_nameDef} had sneezed on the bread. {B_nameDef} said {A_nameDef} had been sniffling first.
Sick in neighboring beds, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} kept count of each other's coughs and complained about the totals.
{A_nameDef} blamed {B_nameDef}'s dirty cup for what was going round. {B_nameDef} blamed {A_nameDef}'s dirty everything.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: argued about who made whom ill

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: an evening at the camp

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} walked over to the strangers' camp in the evening and came back late, full of stories and someone else's stew.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} swapped a basket of bread at the camp for a song they'd never heard, and sang it badly all the way home.
{A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} to meet a family at the camp, and they all sat by the fire until the stars came out.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} spent an afternoon at the camp learning a game played with stones on a board, and lost every round.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: an evening at the camp together

texts.li: {A_nameDef} saw {B_nameDef} slip something to the strangers at the camp and wanted to know what, and why, in front of everyone.
{A_nameDef} accused {B_nameDef} of spending more time at the camp than at work. {B_nameDef} said at least the camp people were pleasant company.
{A_nameDef} counted the stores twice and looked hard at {B_nameDef}, who had been friendly with the camp all week.
{A_nameDef} missed the council meeting and blamed {B_nameDef}, who was there, for how it went.
{A_nameDef} cornered {B_nameDef} after the council had met and wanted to know why nobody had spoken up for {A_objective}.
{A_nameDef} heard from {B_nameDef} what the council had decided while {A_pronoun} was away, and took it out on the messenger.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} found themselves on the same side at the council, and walked out together still making their case to each other.
{B_nameDef} backed {A_nameDef}'s idea at the council when nobody else would, and {A_nameDef} hasn't forgotten it.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} stayed behind after the council had gone, planning how to win the next vote.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: fears in the night

texts.li: {A_nameDef} woke {B_nameDef} in the night, shaking from something {A_pronoun} couldn't name. {B_nameDef} made tea and sat up with {A_objective} until dawn.
{A_nameDef} admitted to {B_nameDef} that {A_pronoun} had been checking the doors three times a night. {B_nameDef} started checking them with {A_objective}, once.
{B_nameDef} found {A_nameDef} awake in the dark, listening to every sound, and stayed until {A_nameDef} fell asleep.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} what frightened {A_objective} most. {B_nameDef} didn't laugh, and didn't tell anyone.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: {B_nameDef} sat up with {A_nameDef} through a frightened night

texts.li: {B_nameDef} took {A_nameDef} out walking on a gray morning, the long way round, and let {A_objective} talk about the one {A_pronoun} had lost.
{B_nameDef} sat with {A_nameDef} by the graves, saying nothing, until {A_nameDef} was ready to go back.
{B_nameDef} took over {A_nameDef}'s chores for a day so that {A_nameDef} could grieve in peace.
{B_nameDef} brought {A_nameDef} a bowl of something warm and an old story about the dead, the funny kind, and {A_nameDef} laughed despite everything.
{A_nameDef} finally said what {A_pronoun} thinks of {B_nameDef}, at supper, with everyone listening. Supper ended early.
{A_nameDef} laid out every grievance {A_pronoun} had with {B_nameDef}, in order, from the first. It took a while.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} exactly what {B_pronoun} could do with {B_possessive} opinions. The room went quiet.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} had it out at last behind the storeroom. It was loud, it was only words, and it settled nothing.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a peace offering

texts.li: After their quarrel, {A_nameDef} left a little carved bird on {B_nameDef}'s bed, with no note. {B_nameDef} knew who it was from.
{A_nameDef} made {B_nameDef}'s favorite supper the day after their argument and set it down in front of {B_objective} without a word.
{A_nameDef} found {B_nameDef} after their spat and said sorry, plainly, which was harder than {A_pronoun} had expected.
{A_nameDef} mended the thing of {B_nameDef}'s that had started the argument, and left it where {B_nameDef} would find it.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: a peace offering after a quarrel

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} found out they missed the same things about home: the bread, the bells, the sound of rain on a proper roof.
{A_nameDef} taught {B_nameDef} a song from home, {B_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} one from {B_possessive}, and they sang both until someone asked them to stop.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} drew maps of where they came from in the dirt and showed each other the best places.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} cooked a dish from home together. It didn't taste right, and they ate every bite.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: something for the hungry

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} set aside part of their own rations for the hungry towns, to go with the next traveler heading that way.
{A_nameDef} talked {B_nameDef} into giving up a meal a week for the towns, then gave up two.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} dried and packed a sack of beans for the hungry, and argued the whole time about the right way to tie the sack.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: put something by for the hungry

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: news of the sick

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat up late talking about the sickness in the towns, and who they knew there, and whether it would come here.
{A_nameDef} made {B_nameDef} promise to wash before every meal until the sickness out there had passed. {B_nameDef} made {A_nameDef} promise the same.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sewed bandages for the sick in the towns all evening, and talked about everything except the sickness.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: worried together about the sickness in the towns
